title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Going to the club tonight?
I get to go on a double date with Jay and his wife. Which is ... fun I guess? I dunno, they’re an interesting duo. You going out?
Sounds interesting enough. What are you guys doing
No, I’m probably just going to go to my aunts and chill
Do you normally go out and get smashed in New Years? I don’t know if I’ve ever spent a New Years doing that TBH?
I haven’t in quite a while. Late-teens, early 20’s I used to. I’ll drink, but not like, go out
Where are you guys going
If I said there was bowling involved would it surprise you Jay wanted to do that?
No, but that’s a cool thing to do
Good thinking on Jay’s part, I feel. Lucky Strike or something?
Bowlero? Think it’s in Clawson?
Have you guys hung out with them before?
Just twice. Once was for a couple drinks, the other time we saw a movie.
That place looks pretty cool
So you’re not just sitting there with Sam talking with Jay and his girlfriend for a whole hr-plus dinner
If that makes any sense
Now, you’re bowling, having some beers, etc.
Right, it should be OK.
How’s the family after today?
Everyone should be good, I’ve been at my house and running errands all day
Are either of these funny and if so, which one would you go with, can’t do both
There were so many stories, I couldn’t choose just one, so here is my favorite story I wrote in 2019: (HAROLD CASTRO DETROIT SPORTS MEDIA ROOKIE OF YEAR link)
Stop the ball I forgot to tweet out my top 17 favorite stories I wrote last year, wait
Oooh man, I enjoy both. I think the second one is funnier to more people
It take off the “wait.” Just Stop the ball I forgot to tweet out my top 17 favorite stories I wrote last year:
K
Should I tweet it like, when the ball is dropping?
Maybe a couple minutes before?
Which do you think there will be more of Alabama touchdowns tomorrow Pro sports teams who use “2020 vision” in their New Years Copy
Man ...
That’s a good one.
I’d go pro sports teams?
Marc and I said the same. But it could be close
